book.name: Matiyu
book.title: Matiyu Zisasiyet yaŋaŋ Matiyuyaŋ meluwaŋ mge

content: Palisi an ekŋengalen zelak zelak mamipgalen zet
Kan keyet Zelusalem mkaengatnaŋ zii zet zikat indanda ma Palisi notnaŋ ekŋenaŋ Zisasmagen koti yaŋkwesimti zewien,
“Nembandine ekŋenaŋ eneyet yeŋsokŋine ekŋengalen zii zet taaŋgosoip? Meu niniyelen kananen bet zululugat set bembeŋaŋ ke ku mamâlip.”
Kegok yaŋkwesime Zisasiyaŋ diindoye, “In zigogat ilinaŋgalen mama mimi gawepumti Kawawaŋgalen zii zet ke mamimyuŋguip?
Kawawaŋgalen zet kapigok tazin,
ma ŋen

content.text: ‘an ŋenaŋ mamaŋ ma bipmaŋgat kwelat zet kuwe beme gakikiyet zapat bewe.’ (Kisim Bek 21:17)

content: Yaŋgut in kapigok manzeip, ‘An ŋen egaŋ mamaŋ ma bipmaŋgat kapigok manzein, “Kwitnaŋ kwitnaŋ it idamti idamukulem mbak yaŋgut keyaŋ neŋ Kawawaŋgat tewalaŋ msasayelen.”’
Am notnaŋaŋ kegok mme in kapigok manzeip, ‘Mamin biwinaŋgat ŋep ku eksemindendeyelen.’ In kegok mti Kawawaŋgalen zet mtopemti ilinaŋgalen mama mimi itnaŋaŋ mamâlip.
In an zetgalen etaŋ! In an keboŋgat golaŋ zenze an Aizayayaŋ zet ŋen kapigok kuye,

content.text: ‘In nâgât belak zelaŋ etaŋ manzeip. In neŋ mandiindoyap ke ku maŋgawepup.
In nâlen zii zet ku tazikat indaip. In ilinaŋgalen zii zet zenâm mip sepem kegogak ke nâlen zii zetnok beingapmti nâgât sekŋinan etaŋ masesewatneip.’” (Aizaya 29:13)

content: Zisas ek zet kegok diindomti am sambe indamandame kopme diindoye, “Neŋ zet diindoma wakbemtati nâmâtâlit!
Anaŋ meu manin ke Kawawaŋaŋmak mama main ku mambekekzin. Keyaŋgut bekanaŋ keŋangatnaŋ makwazin keyaŋ mme yommak mambein.”
Kegok zeme nembaŋane nin egat kandaŋan meti dunduwenn, “Gâlen zet Palisi ekŋen diindonak keyaŋ keŋin mme kipmaŋ bein. Ke nânik?”
Zemann Zisasiyaŋ kapigok dinndoye, “Bien kululuŋen tazin egalen mulupmanen tep msikokok notnaŋ ondemti notnaŋaŋ belak kwakwatnaŋ ke egaŋ kiŋdiŋaŋ melesiŋ seluwe.

Keyepmti in Palisi ekŋen katikindeit. Ekŋen zikalin beŋaŋnok ya zikalin beŋaŋ keyaŋ beŋaŋ notnaŋ ekŋen indamukulem msâgât tapmip yaŋgut an zikatnaŋ beŋaŋaŋ zikatnaŋ beŋaŋ ikŋaŋ nemboŋak teti medak beme ilisakwep aimboŋan towebuk.”
Kegok zeme Pitayaŋ kapigok dunduye, “Geŋ bemzenze zet zenak keyet yaŋaŋ zemane nâne.”
Zeme Zisasiyaŋ dinndoye. “In ewe keyet yaŋaŋ nâmâtâtâpiŋ mamaip?
Keyepmti in kegogak ku nâip. Kaŋgaleminan meu nime kambakŋinaŋ toweti setnaset makwawezin.
Yaŋgut keŋ otnânânaset bekanaŋ makwazin keyaŋ mme nin Kawawaŋgat zikatnan yommak mambenup.

Amgat keŋangatnaŋ ŋoktik bekanaŋ makwazin keyaŋ mme sesepem kapigok masokbeip: Am indome gakiki, awembiŋ kalalaŋ mti mama, an imbi kambu wawat ma imbiyaŋ kegogak mamip, ma set kileŋ mama, kambu titi ma zet dâsuki zenze ma notnaŋgat zet kwelat kuku.
Mama mimi keboŋaŋ Kawawaŋgat zikatnan pembenaŋ ku bein yaŋgut bet ku zuluti meu niniyelen zet keyaŋ Kawawaŋgat zikatnan mme yommak ku talip.”
Imbi Zuda maŋgeen ku sokbembeŋaŋgalen nâmkiŋpepeŋaŋ
Âpme Zisas ma nembaŋane nin mka ke pemti Taia ma Saidon mka temaŋ zut keyet ganzenan mebenn.

Met mamann imbi ŋen Kenan msalengatnaŋ keyaŋ koti Zisasiyet kwizet temaŋ penaŋ kumti zeye, “Amobotnaŋ, geŋ Dewitgalen alikŋaŋaŋ, ya nâgât keŋdi bugan kembeŋ nâne. Nemban we bekanaŋaŋ igagen penaŋ maoyak sain.”
Kegok zeme Zisasiyaŋ nâmtiŋgut zet dopmaŋ ŋen ku gilik zem saye. Kegok mme nembaŋane nin egat zewenn, “Geŋ imbi belak zempemane melak! Ek ningat bamenen koti kwizet takuŋkozin.”
Zemann imbi ke dunduye, “Neŋ Kawawaŋaŋ Islael maŋge sipsip galaŋ zenzeŋaŋ keboŋ keyet zemneme kwatoban.”
Zeme imbiyaŋ koti Zisasiyet kendaŋaŋ pedondom samti zeye, “Amobotnaŋ, geŋ namukulem mne.”
Kegok zeme Zisasiyaŋ ewe dunduye, “An imbi nemba ekŋengalen meu butnaŋ mti tam indame ŋep ku benak.”
Zeme zet dopmaŋ kapigok gilik zemti saye, “Amobotnaŋ, neŋ Islael maŋgeen ku sokbembeŋaŋ e ŋep zenik, yaŋgut tam ekŋenaŋ meu pâpmaŋ toweme ke ŋep manip.”
Kegok zeme nâmti pigok zeye, “Imbi, nâmkiŋpependi temaŋ penaŋ. Keyepmti yaŋkwesinik keyet kataŋ ŋep sokbemgasem.” Zisasiyaŋ kegok zeme keyegak nembaŋaŋ dolakŋaŋ beye.
Zisasiyaŋ am sambe weyaŋindemâge
Âpme Zisasiyaŋ msat keyet peme tapme Galili tundua ganzenaset meti kalaŋan pataŋ zemti mot totage.
Am sambe penaŋ ekŋenaŋ ekmagen kopmâbien. Am notnaŋ sebelin wesiŋ ma zikalin beŋaŋ ma am kopa ma zawalinmak notnaŋ sambe indatimti Zisasiyet kandaŋan maŋge bemindeme indaweyaŋ indeye.
Âpme am kopa ekŋenaŋ zet zewien ma sebelin wesiŋ ekŋenaŋ pembenaŋ bewien ma zikalin beŋaŋ ekŋenaŋ zikalin ekbien. Ke mme amnaŋ ke ekti nâmtemtem mti Islael am ekŋengalen Kawawaŋ zemsesewatpewien.
Zisasiyaŋ am sambe meu indaye

Kegok mti egaŋ nembaŋane nin dinndoye, “Am kasup tuk ninmak tapmien ya alak meuŋinpiŋ talipgapmti neŋ am ekŋengat kembeŋ penaŋ miyap. Mneti meupiŋ zemindema meti selen meuyet zikat gililiŋ mseip keyet yayaŋ mimindeyap.”
Zeme nin yaŋkwesiwenn, “Msat tuŋgupman pi meu desetgatnaŋ aikti indasenup ma am sambe penaŋ indamann nime ŋep bemindesem?”
Kegok yaŋkwesimann egaŋ gilik zem ndayaŋkwesimti zeye, “Inmagen nupmamaŋ zigok tazin?” Kegok ndayaŋkwesime nin zewenn, “Nupmamaŋ 7 ma aŋgala isikŋaŋ bugan tazin.”
Kegok zemann Zisasiyaŋ am zemindeme totabien.
Totapme egaŋ nupmamaŋ 7 ma aŋgala ke mti Kawawaŋgat, “Wisikŋ,” zemti mutumti nembaŋane nin ndame am kalaŋti indawenn.
Indamepmann am sambe ekŋenaŋ nim kiŋgapme butnaŋ tapmege ke makumti beme tise 7 gak zem tage.
Meu nimbien ke an ekŋen makumann 4 tausen kegok bewien. Âpme imbi ma nemba ekŋen ku indamakuwien.
Kegok mti egaŋ am zemindeme mekopme ek ma nembaŋane nsakwep waŋgaen moti met Magadan msalen pataŋ zewenn.
